title: 25th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/25/2/2025).

Question time: Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem asks Minister of Foreign Affairs Dr Abdulla Khaleel whether "Prince" Fahad Saud Al-Shalan, whom President Dr Mohamed Muizzu met on 5 May 2025 and who was described as a Saudi royal, really belongs to the Saudi royal family, why no Saudi Embassy representative attended the meeting, and whether a false claim could harm Maldives-Saudi relations.
From the Speaker's desk: under Rule 272(c) of the Standing Orders, a proposal to amend Chapter 51 of the Standing Orders of Parliament is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Zakat Bill submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the Foreign Minister about the President's meeting with a claimed Saudi prince, sent a Standing Orders amendment to committee, and continued debate on the Zakat Bill.
